abstract_title:
Narrative Self-Continuity, Default Mode Network

Dynamics, and Analytic Idealism
abstract: Experience-First Modeling of Dementia: Late-life neurodegenerative disorders are increasingly understood as disruptions of large-scale brain networks, particularly the default mode network (DMN), which supports autobiographical memory, self-referential processing, and mental time travel. Early Alzheimer’s disease and related conditions show DMN dysconnectivity and reduced signal complexity years before overt dementia.
